ui.providers-schedule.a-command-is-requi: A command is required and can’t contain line breaks or other control characters
ui.providers-schedule.a-name-is-required: A name is required, up to 60 characters
ui.providers-schedule.absolute-path-of-t: Absolute path of the executable, or a name on PATH
ui.providers-schedule.an-external-cli-ru: An external CLI runs on your computer as you, so only add programs you trust. Nomi asks you before every tool call (Ask each time).
ui.providers-schedule.argument-uses-the-: Argument {0} uses the unknown placeholder {1} (only {2} are allowed)
ui.providers-schedule.at-most-32-argumen: At most 32 arguments, each up to 512 characters, with no line breaks
ui.providers-schedule.claude-code-codex-: Claude Code / Codex / dsh / Grok / Gemini CLI, plus coding assistant tabs in Nomi.
ui.providers-schedule.connect-any-coding: Connect any coding assistant that speaks ACP (Agent Client Protocol). Only the command, arguments and environment variable names are saved; no third-party code is loaded.
ui.providers-schedule.couldn-t-detect-it: Couldn't detect it; restart Nomi and try again
ui.providers-schedule.default-account-ch: Default account changed to {0}; tabs that follow the default switch on their next message
ui.providers-schedule.delete-the-externa: Delete the external CLI “{0}”? Tabs that use it stay, but they can’t send messages anymore.
ui.providers-schedule.each-account-has-i: Each account has its own configuration folder and {0} handles sign-in itself; Nomi doesn’t store sign-in credentials. Different tabs can use different accounts at the same time; the default account is used by new tabs and tabs that follow the default.
ui.providers-schedule.generated-with-the: Generated with the current chat model when due; results go to the chat window, and Nomi's bubble lets you know (the Dynamic Island or a system notification while she is closed). Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to save
ui.providers-schedule.have-nomi-give-you: Have Nomi give you a briefing every morning, or remind you to write your weekly report every Friday.
ui.providers-schedule.lowercase-letters-: Lowercase letters, digits and - only; after saving it identifies the tabs and conversations
ui.providers-schedule.manage-versions-an: Manage versions and official accounts for Claude Code / Codex / dsh / Grok / Gemini, and progress monitoring for local coding assistants. Third-party models for Nomi and every assistant are set in Models.
ui.providers-schedule.names-only-such-as: Names only (such as MY_TOKEN). Values are inherited from the environment Nomi was started in, and Nomi doesn’t store them.
ui.providers-schedule.notification-style: Notification style and types are set in Notifications / Dynamic Island; quiet hours are set in Schedule.
ui.providers-schedule.one-per-line-you-c: One per line; you can use {0} (working folder) and {1} (home folder). No shell is involved, so variables and wildcards are not expanded.
ui.providers-schedule.only-sessions-whos: Only sessions whose files were just written and whose process is still running count, de-duplicated per session. Reads local logs and the process list only — never signs in or scrapes any account.
ui.providers-schedule.pick-the-coding-as: Pick the coding assistant to view; the picker shows install status.
ui.providers-schedule.ran-the-result-was: “{0}” ran; the result was sent to the chat window
ui.providers-schedule.read-task-status-a: Read task status and periodic summaries aloud in addition to the chime; when off, only the chime plays. Respects the voice switch and mute.
ui.providers-schedule.ready-to-chat-she-: Ready to chat; she'll speak up at random while you're idle
ui.providers-schedule.reminders-due-duri: Reminders due during do-not-disturb are held and delivered together afterwards; scheduled tasks still run, with results only written to the chat window. Spanning midnight is supported (e.g. 22:30 – 08:00).
ui.providers-schedule.remove-the-account: Remove the account “{0}”? {1} will be signed out in this account’s folder (revoking the sign-in) and the folder will be deleted. Conversation history is kept.
ui.providers-schedule.requests-go-throug: Requests go through the Nomi gateway, which converts protocols. Each {0} tab can pick the official account or a third party from the top-right of the chat, independently, without changing the CLI global config.
ui.providers-schedule.show-a-bubble-dyna: Show a bubble / Dynamic Island notice when a task finishes, fails, stalls or waits for confirmation.
ui.providers-schedule.sign-in-happens-in: Sign-in happens in this account’s own configuration folder through {0}’s official flow. Nomi doesn’t store sign-in credentials, and other accounts aren’t affected.
ui.providers-schedule.sign-in-to-it-in-a: Sign in to it in a terminal first ({0}).
ui.providers-schedule.signed-in-as-you-c: Signed in as {0}. You can make it the default account, or pick it for a single tab.
ui.providers-schedule.the-id-can-only-us: The id can only use lowercase letters, digits and -, up to 40 characters
ui.providers-schedule.the-main-process-w: The main-process watcher isn't reachable in this environment.
ui.providers-schedule.this-id-is-already: This id is already used by a built-in coding assistant
ui.providers-schedule.this-identity-is-a: This identity is also signed in under “{0}”. When the same account refreshes its sign-in in two places, one of them stops working, so keep only one.
ui.providers-schedule.what-should-the-as: What should the assistant do? e.g. Summarize today's reminders and give me a word of encouragement
ui.providers-schedule.when-on-nomi-occas: When on, Nomi occasionally starts a chat while you're idle (using topics from long-term memory). Off by default; never during do-not-disturb hours, right after you've chatted, or while you're away.
ui.providers-schedule.write-environment-: Write environment variable names only (such as MY_TOKEN), not values
